authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 603 aratni explicitly gives Lahnda arak and awāṇ āruk elbow, with kk from tn. The addendum documents ṛ before k in regional elbow forms, supporting ārak/āṛak without inventing a separate root. Exact survey form āṛak is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
